stem: Which record best preserves seed-lot provenance before germination begins?
choices: Only the cultivar name is needed.
Only the number that germinated is needed.
Source, lot ID, count, storage context and any pre-treatment are recorded before the seed is handled.
Provenance can be reconstructed after emergence from plant appearance.
rationale: Source, lot ID, count, storage context and any pre-treatment are recorded before the seed is handled.
